source: Lin et al 2025, arXiv 2504.13171, Figure 3 right panel (GSM8K-Symbolic P2). Marker centres read from the PDF vector paths with pdfplumber, calibrated on the axis tick lines. Series identified by line colour (grey = test-time only, blue = sleep-time) and by which group reaches higher accuracy (gpt-4o above gpt-4o-mini). Model assignment is inferred, not printed in the figure. Precision about plus or minus 0.02 accuracy and plus or minus 5 tokens.
replication_target: gpt-4o-mini, P2, verbosity 0 prompts: test-time only about 0.05, sleep-time about 0.36, at about 27 test-time completion tokens per question.
